sentences.l: And-then they-arose for-war after 3 months from city-of ምስፍና with Makeda mother-his and-Zion lady-his, and-Levites they-carry-her the-ark-of law with furnishing-of tent-their(?), and-while they-march in-much awe like then on-mount Sinai when brought-down-her God from-heavens Zion in-holiness to Moses and-Aaron; and-likewise they-carry-her the-ark-of law Azarias and-Elmeyas and-others sons-of host-of Israel, while they-march on-her-right and-on-her-left, at-side-her, at-end-her(?) and-at-behind-her, while they-praise and-sing, while earthly-ones like host-of heavenly-ones;
sentences.i: And then, after three months, they set out for war from the city of Məsfəna, together with Makeda his mother and Zion his lady, and the Levites carried the Ark of the Law with the furnishings of their tent (?). They marched in great awe, as at that time on Mount Sinai when God brought Zion down from heaven in holiness to Moses and Aaron. In the same way Azarias and Elmeyas and the other sons of the host of Israel carried the Ark of the Law, marching on its right and on its left, at its side, at its end (?) and behind it, praising and singing, earthly men like the host of the heavenly ones.
sentences.n: The war-march sets out from Məsfəna (ምስፍና, a place name, also “rule”) with the Ark carried in solemn procession, and the text compares it to the Sinai theophany: the Ark (here called Zion, ጽዮን) is brought down from heaven to Moses and Aaron, so the march is a re-enactment of the giving of the Law. Zion is the Ark itself, spoken of as a person, “his lady.” ይጸውርዋ is “they carry her” (ጾረ, with ‑ዋ “her”; the Ark is feminine). ንዋየ ሐቢቶሙ, “furnishing of their ሐቢት,” is uncertain (?): ሐቢት is not clear to me, perhaps a tent or covering (?). ምስለ and ወ- are “with” and “and”; the construct chains ደቂቀ ኀይለ እስራኤል “sons of the host of Israel” and ታቦተ ሕግ “ark of the law” (ሕግ = law) carry the sense. Azarias is the son of Zadok the high priest, as in the earlier parts; ኤልሚያስ is Elmeyas, one of the companions. በፍጽማ “at its end” (?) and በኳላሃ “behind it” (?) are guesses from context. sentences.i: And God gave them a good voice and a wondrous melody, for God was pleased to be praised through them. And they arrived from the city of Məsfəna and came to (?) the water of the fathers (?); and at dawn they destroyed the land of Zaw with Hadya;
sentences.n: The singing is God’s gift, so the march itself praises him. ወወሀቦሙ is ወሀበ “give” with ‑ሙ “them.” In እምህገረ ምስፍና the source prints ህገረ, a slip for ሀገረ “city of”; it is kept as printed. ወበጽሑ እምህገረ is “and they arrived from the city of” (እም- is “from”, not “at”), that is, having come out of Məsfəna. ተዐየኑ is the house word “were seen / met face to face” (?); with a place as object it is read here as “met, came upon, came to” (?), and the same hedge applies wherever it recurs in this part. በማየ አበው “at the water of the fathers” may be a place name (?). አጥፍእዋ is አጠፍአ “destroy” + ‑ዋ “it/her.” ዛዉ and ሐድያ are peoples or lands I take as names (Hadya is the known land of southern Ethiopia); Zaw is unidentified (?).

sentences.n: Two source slips, ህገረ for ሀገረ “city, land of,” are kept as printed (here and at the end of the unit). ሰባድዕት is taken as a people’s name (?). sentences.i: And the king of Candace brought gifts and gada (?), and he himself bowed down before the king of Ethiopia. Wherever he wished and fought, none could overcome him, except he who overcomes, himself (?);
sentences.n: ወጋዳ keeps the house reading of ጋዳ as some kind of gift (?). ሰገደ is “bowed down, did homage.” ለሊሁ is the emphatic “himself.” ዘይመውኦ is “who would overcome him” (ሞዐ “conquer, overcome”, as in ch. 88), and ዘእንበለ ዘይመውእ ለሊሁ, “except he who conquers, himself,” is obscure (?): taken literally, no one overcomes him but the one who overcomes, himself; it may mean that the king is his own conqueror, so that no other can be.

sentences.i: And those who watch him closely (?) in the midst of his host, so that they may hear the news and tell it to their own lands, are not able to run in a cart, for Zion herself wearies the strength of the enemy.
sentences.n: The sense of ያስተሓይጽዎ is uncertain (?): I read it, with the house entry (ch. 25, 30), as “those who watch him closely,” the enemy’s spies or observers who would carry the news home. ትዕይንቱ I take as “his host in array” (the house reading of ትዕይንት, ?). ከመ ይስምዑ ወይንግሩ is “that they may hear and tell.” ረዊጸ is “to run” (the infinitive of the verb in ይረውጹ below), said of travelling by cart; “to flee” would be a guess. ታደክም is the causative “she makes weary”; ለሊሃ ጽዮን, “Zion herself,” makes the Ark the fighter, not the army.

sentences.n: ዘይትለአክ is the tä-stem of ለአከ “serve, minister” (3ms imperfect; “is sent” is also possible, as in ch. 25) (?): ደብተራ is the tent (tabernacle), and the king is the one who ministers at it, as David did before Zion. ፈቃዲ is “his will” (-ዲ for -ሁ, Bezold’s spelling, as in the earlier parts). ይትገበር is the passive “it is done.” ዘፈቀደ ወዘኀለየ ወዘአንጸረ is the three “whatever he wished, thought, pointed at,” where አንጸረ (“looked toward, regarded” in ch. 49–50) is rendered “points to (?)” only as a guess from በአጽባዕቱ “with his fingers.” ወኵሉ ይፈርሆ “and all fear him.”

sentences.i: But as for him, there is no one he fears, for the hand of God is with him, which guards him night and day, because he did his will (?). And he in his turn does it for him, and he guards him from all evil, for ever and ever. Amen.
sentences.n: ወውእቱሰ “but as for him” turns from the people’s fear of the king to the king’s freedom from fear. እደ እግዚኣብሔር, “the hand of God,” is feminine here, hence እንተ ተዐቅቦ “which guards him.” ገብረ ፈቃዶ “he did his will”: whose will is not marked. Since ወውእቱኒ ይገብር ሎቱ means “and he in turn does for him,” I take it that God did the king’s will and the king now does God’s (?); the other reading, the king doing God’s will, is possible. The closing ለዓለመ ዓለም አሜን, “for ever and ever, Amen,” ends the chapter; one ፨ follows.

sentences.i: And Dematyos of Antioch said, “Yes, what was written seems true up to the day of Solomon’s death. But after his death, as for what was written, it is like it, from other prophets (?).” (The text ends with a row of nine ፨ signs.)
sentences.n: Colophon, continued (ይመስል is “it resembles, it seems”): Dematyos of Antioch (ድማትዮስ, the same name as the Dematyos of Rome in ch. 18; he is not identified with Demetrius) answers that the text is accepted up to Solomon’s death, and after that it is written in the manner of other prophets (?). The last clause, እምባዕዳን ነቢያት ዘተጽሕፈ አምሳሉ, is uncertain (?): “from other prophets, what was written, its likeness.” The row of ፨ signs closes the whole book, attached to this last unit as in earlier parts.

glossary.ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
glossary.ለፀብእ: ፀብእ — war, battle (noun; ለ- 'for, to': ተንሥኡ ለፀብእ 'they set out for war')
glossary.ሊቃነ: ሊቅ — chief, elder (noun; plural construct 'chiefs of')
glossary.ሌሊተ: ሌሊት — night (noun, fem., accusative; adverbial 'by night')
glossary.ሐቌሆሙ: ሐቅው — their loins (ሐቅው 'loins, hips' + -ሆሙ 'their'; written ሐቌ-)
glossary.ሐቢቶሙ: ሐቢት — (?) tent, dwelling (noun, + -ሙ 'their'); lemma and sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ሐድያ: ሐድያ — Hadya (proper name, a land or people)
glossary.ሕግ: ሕግ — law (noun) · collective 'laws' after a plural demonstrative (ለእሉ ሕግ ወአስማት 'these laws and names')
glossary.ሖረ: ሖረ — he went (3m sg perfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.መሬታዊያን: መሬታዊ — earthly ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
glossary.መንክረ: መንክር — wondrous, marvellous (adjective, accusative, agreeing with ዜማ)
glossary.መጠነ: መጠን — measure; መጠነ 'as far as, according to the measure of' (construct as conjunction/preposition)
glossary.ማክዳ: ማክዳ — Makeda (proper name, the Queen of Sheba)
glossary.ምሕዋረ: ምሕዋር — journey, way (noun; accusative, construct 'a journey of' thirteen days)
glossary.ምስፍና: ምስፍና — Məsfəna (place name), the same word as the common noun ምስፍና 'rule, lordship', from which the city's name is taken (?)
glossary.ምድያም: ምድያም — Midian (proper name; ንጉሠ ምድያም 'king of Midian')
glossary.ሞቱሰ: ሞት — his death, as for it (noun + -ሁ 'his' + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ሠምረ: ሠምረ — he willed, was pleased (3ms perfect, G, ś-m-r)
glossary.ሠናየ: ሠናይ — good (accusative, adj. as noun) · adjective 'good, fine' agreeing with a noun (ልብሰ ሠናየ 'a fine garment')
glossary.ረዊጸ: ሮጸ — to run (infinitive, accusative ረዊጸ; r-w-ṣ)
glossary.ሰማያዊያን: ሰማያዊ — heavenly ones (adjective, plural -ያን, used as noun)
glossary.ሰባድዕት: ሰባድዕት — Sabadʿət (proper name of a people) (?)
glossary.ሰብእ: ሰብእ — man, human being, people (noun) · 'humankind' (መፍቀሬ ሰብእ 'lover of humankind')
glossary.ሰአሉ: ሰአለ — they asked (3mp perfect, G, s-ʾ-l)
glossary.ሶፍያ: ሶፍያ — Sophia, Wisdom (proper name; Greek loan)
glossary.ቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — first (adj.) · adverbial 'first' after ኀበ (ኀበ ቀዳሚ ተወጠነ 'where it first began')
glossary.ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?) · accusative 'a voice' (ቃለ ሠናየ 'a good voice')
glossary.በማየ: ማይ — with the water of (በ- + construct plural ማያት/ማየ)
glossary.በብዙኅ: ብዙኅ — with much (በ- + adjective, masc. sg.)
glossary.በኀበ: ኀበ — before, with, in the presence of (በ- + ኀበ) · among (በኀበ ማእምራን 'among the knowing') · 'where' (conj.) (በኀበ ሀለውኩ 'where I am') · 'of, from' after ሰአለ (ሰአሉ በኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'they asked of God')
glossary.በአሐቲ: አሐዱ — with one (በ- + fem. numeral አሐቲ) · 'by one' (በአሐቲ ፍናው 'by one road')
glossary.በአጽባዕቱ: ጽባዕ — with his fingers (በ- 'with' + plural አጽባዕት + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.በአፈ: አፍ — by the mouth of (በ- + noun, construct አፈ)
glossary.በየማና: የማን — on her right (በ- + noun 'right hand' + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.በገቦሃ: ገቦ — her side (በ- 'at, on' + ገቦ 'side, flank' + -ሃ 'her', 3fs)
glossary.በፍጽማ: ፍጽም — her end (?) (በ- 'at' + ፍጽም 'end, completion' + -ኣ 'her', 3fs); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ባ: በ — in her, in it (preposition በ- + -ኣ '3fs', written ባ, as in ባቲ); or 'she has' (ቦ with -ኣ, possession) (?)
glossary.ባሕረ: ባሕር — sea (noun, accusative of place 'by sea') · accusative object or goal: 'reached the sea' (ወበጽሑ ባሕረ), 'crossed the sea' (ዐደዉ ባሕረ), 'came out of the sea' (ወወፅኡ ባሕረ), ch. 55 · construct 'sea of' (ባሕረ ኢርትራ 'the Sea of Erythra, the Red Sea')
glossary.ቦሙ: በ — by them, in them (preposition በ- + -ሙ '3mp', ቦሙ)
glossary.ተንሥኡ: ተንሥአ — rise! (2mp imperative, Gt) · they arose (3mp perfect) · they set out, departed (ተንሥኡ ለፀብእ 'they set out for war')
glossary.ተዐቅቦ: ዐቀበ — she guards him (3fs imperfect, G, + -ኦ 'him'; agrees with እንተ ... እደ)
glossary.ተዐየኑ: ተዐየነ — they were seen, met face to face (?) (3mp perfect, tä-stem of ዐየነ 'look at'); exact sense uncertain (?) · before a place name, 'met, came upon' (?), rendered 'came to (?)' (ተዐየኑ ጌርሳ 'they came to (?) Gersa'; ተዐየኑ ሳባ; ተዐየኑ በማየ አበው); the hedge holds at each use
glossary.ታቦተ: ታቦት — ark, tabernacle (construct 'ark of') · also accusative 'an ark' (ግበር ታቦተ 'make an ark')
glossary.ታደክም: አደከመ — she wearies (3fs imperfect, causative of ደክመ 'be weary')
glossary.ትዕይንቱ: ትዕይንት — his host in array, procession (noun + -ሁ 'his'); sense uncertain (?)
glossary.ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam') · opening a title-like clause, 'how' or 'when' (ኀበ አስሐተቶ ለሰሎሞን ወለተ ፈርዖን 'how Pharaoh's daughter led Solomon astray') (?)
glossary.ኀይለ: ኀይል — strength (noun, accusative ኀይለ) · construct 'host of' (ኀይለ ሰማይ 'host of heaven') · 'power' (ትገብሩ ኀይለ ከማየ 'you do power like me') · construct 'power of' (ኀይለ ጸላኢ 'the power of the enemy')
glossary.ኀጺን: ኀጺን — iron (noun; በአፈ ኀጺን 'by the edge of iron', i.e. the sword)
glossary.ንዋየ: ንዋይ — goods, vessels, possessions (construct 'goods of') · accusative 'goods' (ወኵሎ ንዋየ ወሀበት 'and all goods she gave')
glossary.ንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — king (accusative) · also construct 'king of' (ንጉሠ ሮምሂ 'the king of Rome too') · predicate accusative 'as king' (ዘይከውን ንጉሠ 'who will be king'; ይኩነነ ንጉሠ 'may he be king for us')
glossary.አልቦ: አልቦ — there is not, none (negative existential) · 'no, not so' as a reply (አልቦ እግዚኦ 'No, O lord', ch. 56)
glossary.አመ: አመ — on, at the time of, when (preposition / conjunction)
glossary.አማንኬ: አማን — truly, is it true? (adverb 'truly' + interrogative -ኬ)
glossary.አምሳሉ: አምሳል — his/its likeness, like it (noun + -ሁ); አምሳሉ 'its likeness'
glossary.አብዓት: አብዓት — Abʿat (proper name, a place or people) (?)
glossary.አዛርያስ: አዛርያስ — Azariah (proper name; here son of Zadok, high priest)
glossary.አጥፍኡ: አጠፍአ — they destroyed (3mp perfect, causative of ጠፍአ)
glossary.አጥፍእዋ: አጠፍአ — they destroyed her/it (3mp perfect, causative of ጠፍአ, + -ዋ 'her, it', 3fs)
glossary.አጥፍእዎሙ: አጠፍአ — they destroyed them (3mp perfect, causative of ጠፍአ, + -ዎሙ 'them')
glossary.እመዋዕለ: መዋዕል — from the days of (እም- 'from' + construct plural መዋዕል, the plural of ዕለት 'day')
glossary.እመጻሕፍት: መጽሐፍ — from the books (እም- 'from' + plural መጻሕፍት of መጽሐፍ 'book')
glossary.እሙ: እም — his mother (noun + -ሁ '3ms his', contracted እሙ) · 'its mother' of an animal (ጽጉበ ሐሊበ እሙ 'sated with its mother's milk'; ch. 53)
glossary.እምህገረ: ሀገር — from the city of (እም- 'from' + construct 'city of'; spelled ህገረ for ሀገረ)
glossary.እምሰማያት: ሰማይ — from the heavens (እም- + plural ሰማያት)
glossary.እምቀዳሚ: ቀዳሚ — from the first, from the beginning (እም- + adj. as noun)
glossary.እምባዕዳን: ባዕድ — from others (እም- 'from' + plural ባዕዳን of ባዕድ 'other')
glossary.እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
glossary.እምኵሉ: ኵሉ — out of all, from all (እም- 'from' + ኵሉ) · more than all (እምኵሉ with አፍቀረተኪ 'she loved you more than all')
glossary.እምዘ: ዘ — from him who (እም- + relative pronoun) · 'beyond what' (እምዘ ኢተሐዘብኩ 'beyond what I had expected') · 'from what' (እምዘ ንኤዝዘከ 'from what we command you') · 'since' of time (እምዘ ኀለፉ 'since they passed') · 'in respect of what' (እምዘ ንሰምዕ 'in what we hear')
glossary.እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
glossary.እስከ: እስከ — until, as far as (preposition) · እስከ — conjunction before a verb, 'until' (እስከ የዐዝዞ ማይ 'until the water seizes him')
glossary.እንተ: እንተ — which, who (rel. pron. fem.) · in the phrase እንተ ባሕቲቱ 'privately, apart' (lit. 'which his solitude'; here the son is drawn aside alone) · fem. relative before a noun, ሐወጸ እንተ ታዕካ ቤተ መንግሥት 'looked out (?), which the ታዕካ of the palace'; the link to the verb is unclear (?) · 'which is' of the place (እንተ ኀበ ቊልፈትክሙ 'which is at your backside (?)') · 'whose' before a possessed noun (እንተ ስማ አቢስ 'whose name is Abishag') · እንተ የብስ 'which [is] dry land': the relative standing after a feminine noun, ባሕር (ትተረጐም, 3fs, shows it is feminine), 'the sea, which [became] dry land'; a prepositional 'by, on' is possible but less likely (?) · fem. relative or link before an adverb of place, 'who/which [was]' (ወሖረት እንተ ድኅሬሁ 'and she went [she] behind him'; ቆብዐ እንተ መትሕተ አክሊሉ 'a cap which [was] beneath his crown') · fem. relative before a verb, 'which' (እንተ ሄደ 'which went (?)') · 'by, along' before a place, perhaps prepositional (እንተ ፍኖተ አዝያባ 'by the road of Azyaba'; እንተ መሰስ 'by Mäsäs') (?) · 'of' before a genitive, standing for the feminine relative (ሃይማኖት እንተ አበው ሐዋርያት 'the faith of the fathers, the apostles'; ሃይማኖተ እንተ ቤተ ክርስቲያን 'the faith of the Church') · fem. relative before a verb with the object understood (ሥጋ እንተ ነሥአ 'the flesh which he took')
glossary.እንዘ: እንዘ — while, whilst (conjunction) · 'while', also 'though' in contrast (እንዘ ክቡር ስምነ 'though our name was honored')
glossary.ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
glossary.ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
glossary.ወለንጉሥ: ንጉሥ — and to the king, and of the king (ወ- + ለ- + noun)
glossary.ወሌዋዊያን: ሌዋዊ — and the Levites (ወ- + plural ሌዋዊያን of ሌዋዊ 'Levite')
glossary.ወመዐልተ: መዐልት — and day (ወ- + noun, accusative; adverbial 'by day')
glossary.ወማኅደሩ: ማኅደር — and his dwelling place (ወ- + noun + -ሁ 'his')
glossary.ወሰራዊተ: ሰራዊት — and host, army (ወ- + noun, construct 'army of')
glossary.ወሰገደ: ሰገደ — and he bowed down (ወ- + 3ms perfect, s-g-d)
glossary.ወቀተልዎሙ: ቀተለ — and they killed them (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, + -ዎሙ 'them')
glossary.ወበነግህ: ነግህ — and at dawn (ወ- + በ- 'at' + ነግህ 'dawn, early morning')
glossary.ወበኳላሃ: ኳላ — and behind her (?) (ወ- + በ- 'at' + ኳላ 'back, rear' (?) + -ሃ 'her', 3fs); the word is not identified (cf. ወኳላ, ch. 38–39), sense from context (?)
glossary.ወበገቢረ: ገብረ — and in the doing of (ወ- + በ- 'in' + infinitive ገቢረ, G; construct)
glossary.ወበጽሑ: በጽሐ — and they arrived (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወበፀጋማ: ፀጋም — and on her left (ወ- + በ- + noun 'left' + -ኣ '3fs her')
glossary.ወባዕዳን: ባዕድ — and others, strangers (ወ- + plural ባዕዳን of ባዕድ 'other, foreign')
glossary.ወተኃለፉ: ተኃለፈ — and they passed on (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem of ኀለፈ 'pass')
glossary.ወተዐየነት: ተዐየነ — and she was seen, met (?) (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem of ዐየነ); exact sense uncertain (?); with ውስተ ሀገረ rendered 'came to (?)'
glossary.ወተዐየኑ: ተዐየነ — and they were seen, met (?) (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem of ዐየነ 'look at'); exact sense uncertain (?); before a place name rendered 'came to (?)'
glossary.ወኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at (preposition; ወ- 'and') · and where, and wherever (conjunction, ወኀበ ሖረ ይተልዎ 'and wherever he went it pursued him') · 'and to' a thing, 'wherever' (ወኀበ ኵሉ ዘፈቀደ 'and to every [place] he wished')
glossary.ወነበሩ: ነበረ — and they stayed, lived (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, n-b-r)
glossary.ወንጉሠ: ንጉሥ — and king of (ወ- + noun, construct)
glossary.ወንጉሥሰ: ንጉሥ — and the king indeed (ወ- + noun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
glossary.ወአብአ: አብአ — bring in, present (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, causative አ-, of ቦአ 'enter')
glossary.ወአንሥኡ: አንሥአ — and they raised (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative)
glossary.ወአጥፍኡ: አጠፍአ — and they destroyed (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ጠፍአ)
glossary.ወአጥፍእዋ: አጠፍአ — and they destroyed her/it (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative of ጠፍአ, + -ዋ 'her, it')
glossary.ወኢምንተኒ: ምንት — and not anything, nothing (ወ- + ኢ- + 'what' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወኢይክሉ: ክህለ — and they are not able (ወ- + ኢ- 'not' + 3mp imperfect ይክሉ, G)
glossary.ወኤልሚያስ: ኤልሚያስ — and Elmeyas (ወ- 'and' + proper name, a companion of Azarias)
glossary.ወእለ: እለ — and those who (ወ- + relative pl.)
glossary.ወእምህየ: ህየ — and from there (ወ- + እም- 'from' + adverb)
glossary.ወከማሁ: ከማሁ — and likewise (ወ- 'and' + adverb, 'like him, thus')
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወኵሎሙ: ኵሉ — and all of them, and all (ወ- + ኵሉ + -ሙ '3mp')
glossary.ወወሀቦሙ: ወሀበ — and he gave them (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -omu, w-h-b)
glossary.ወውእቱሰ: ውእቱ — and he, as for him (ወ- + pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወውእቱኒ: ውእቱ — and he also (ወ- + pronoun + enclitic -ኒ)
glossary.ወዘኀለየ: ኀለየ — and what he thinks, intends (ወ- + ዘ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወዘነበ: ዘነብ — and tail of (ወ- + noun, construct ዘነበ 'tail of')
glossary.ወዘአንጸረ: አንጸረ — and what he looks toward, regards (ወ- + ዘ- + 3ms perfect, causative of ነጸረ 'look'); 'points to' is a guess from 'with his fingers' (?)
glossary.ወዜማ: ዜማ — and melody, chant (ወ- + noun, accusative)
glossary.ወየዐቅቦ: ዐቀበ — and he guards him (ወ- + 3ms imperfect, G, + -ኦ 'him')
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይንግሩ: ነገረ — and they tell (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G)
glossary.ወይዜምሩ: ዘመረ — and they sing (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ይዜምሩ; z-m-r 'sing psalms')
glossary.ወገብአት: ገብአ — she returned (3fs perfect, G, g-b-ʾ; ወ- 'and')
glossary.ወጋዳ: ጋዳ — unidentified word, perhaps a kind of gift (ወ- 'and') (?)
glossary.ወፀብአ: ፀብአ — and he fought, made war (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G) · or ወ- + noun ፀብእ 'and war', accusative (?)
glossary.ወፀብኡ: ፀብአ — and they fought, made war (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, verb)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors') · upon, on (ውስተ ሐቌያቲሆሙ 'upon their hips'; ውስተ መንበረ አቡሁ 'on his father's throne')
glossary.ዕለተ: ዕለት — day (noun, fem., construct state 'day-of') · also the accusative singular after a numeral (፯ ዕለተ 'seven days')
glossary.ዘቤተ: ቤት — of the house of (ዘ- 'of, that of' + ቤተ, construct 'house of')
glossary.ዘተጽሕፈ: ተጽሕፈ — which was written (ዘ- + 3ms perfect, ተ- passive of ጸሐፈ)
glossary.ዘእንበለ: ዘእንበለ — without, except (preposition) · conjunction 'without' + jussive (ዘእንበለ ይስቅይዋ 'without their watering her') · conjunction + perfect 'without (its having been done)' (ዘእንበለ ተሀበኒ ትእምርተ 'without a sign having been given me') · 'except' (ዘእንበለ ዘተሐምም 'except what she suffered') · conjunction 'before' + subjunctive (ዘእንበለ ይስአሉ አበዊነ ንጉሠ 'before our fathers asked for a king') (?)
glossary.ዘየኀጥኡ: ኀጥአ — which they lack, miss (ዘ- + 3mp imperfect, G, ḫ-ṭ-ʾ; 'lack' taken from context, the usual sense being 'err, miss') (?)
glossary.ዘይመውእ: ሞዐ — he who overcomes (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G; the printed አ stands for ዐ, as in ch. 88) (?)
glossary.ዘይመውኦ: ሞዐ — who overcomes him (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G, + -ኦ 'him'; the printed አ stands for ዐ, as in ch. 88; አልቦ ዘይመውኦ 'there is none who overcomes him') (?)
glossary.ዘይትለአክ: ተለአከ — who serves, ministers (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, tä-stem of ለአከ 'send'; 'is sent' also possible) (?)
glossary.ዘይፈርህ: ፈርሀ — whom he fears, he who fears (ዘ- + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.ዘፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — what he wished (ዘ- relative + 3ms perfect)
glossary.የሐውሩ: ሖረ — they go (3mp imperfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ያመጽኡ: አምጽአ — they bring, brought (3mp subjunctive, causative of መጽአ 'come'; after እስከ 'until')
glossary.ያስተሓይጽዎ: አስተሓየጸ — they watch him closely (?) (3mp imperfect, ʾastä-stem, + -ዎ 'him'; root and sense uncertain, as in ch. 25, 30) (?)
glossary.ያወርዳ: አውረደ — he brings down, brought down (3ms imperfect, causative of ወረደ 'descend', + -ኣ 'her', 3fs, written ዳ after the ድ; ከመ አመ ያወርዳ 'as when he brought her down')
glossary.ይሜግባ: ይሜግባ — unidentified verb with -ኣ '3fs her'; read from context 'he moves her' (?)
glossary.ይረው: ሮጸ — they run (3mp imperfect; ይረውጹ split by a wordspace as ይረው ፡ ጹ) (?)
glossary.ይሴባሕ: ሰብሐ — that he be praised (3ms subjunctive, passive of ሰብሐ 'praise'; ከመ ይሴባሕ ቦሙ 'that he be praised through them')
glossary.ይሴብሑ: ሰብሐ — they praise (3mp imperfect, G; ይሴብሑ)
glossary.ይበጽሑ: በጽሐ — they would reach (3mp imperfect/subjunctive, G, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ይትኤዘዙ: ተኤዘዘ — they obey (3mp imperfect, tä-stem of አዘዘ 'command'; takes በ- 'by' of the word)
glossary.ይትገበር: ተገብረ — it is done (3ms imperfect, tä-stem passive of ገብረ)
glossary.ይነብር: ነበረ — he stays, dwells (3ms imperfect, G, n-b-r) · he sits, is seated (3ms imperfect, G, of sitting at table) · he will sit, take the seat (ዝንቱ ይነብር ህየንቴሁ 'this one will sit in his place')
glossary.ይገብር: ገብረ — he does, makes (3ms imperfect, G, g-b-r)
glossary.ይጸውርዋ: ጾረ — they carry her (3mp imperfect, G, + -ዋ 'her', 3fs; ይጸውሩ)
glossary.ይፈርሆ: ፈርሀ — he fears him (3m sg imperfect + -o, f-r-h)
glossary.ደቂቀ: ደቂቅ — sons, children (plural ደቂቅ, construct 'sons of')
glossary.ደወለ: ደወል — boundary, border (noun; construct/accusative 'boundary of'; uncertain)
glossary.ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
glossary.ድማትዮስ: ድማትዮስ — Dəmatyos (proper name; not identified with Demetrius, whose Geʿez form would be ድሜጥሮስ)
glossary.ገብረ: ገብረ — make, do (3ms perfect) · here the noun ገብር 'servant' in the construct state, ገብረ ፈርዖን 'servant of Pharaoh' · accusative 'a slave' after አልቦ (ወአልቦ ገብረ 'and there is no slave')
glossary.ገጾሙ: ገጽ — their faces (noun + -ሆሙ '3mp their', written ገጾሙ)
glossary.ጋእዘ: ጋእዘ — (?) unidentified word; perhaps a name or a verb (?)
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct) · Egypt as goal of a journey, accusative without a preposition (ርደተ አብርሃም ግብጽ 'descent of Abraham to Egypt') · the Egyptians (ርእይዎሙ ግብጽ 'the Egyptians saw them')
glossary.ጹ: ሮጸ — ጹ: final syllable of ይረውጹ 'they run' (3mp imperfect), split off by a wordspace in the source (?)
glossary.ፀብአ: ፀብእ — war, battle (noun, accusative) · also construct 'war of' (ፀብአ ሰይጣን 'the war of Satan') (?)
glossary.ፈቃዲ: ፈቃድ — his will (noun + -ዲ for 3ms -ሁ 'his', Bezold's spelling as in ወልዲ; ለገቢረ ፈቃዲ 'to doing his will')
glossary.ፍኖቱ: ፍኖት — his road, way (noun, fem. + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.፫: ፫ — 3, spoken ሠለስቱ (śälästu) 'three'; chapter number (numeral) · also a counted number 'three' (መጠነ ፫ እመት 'to the measure of three cubits'; ፫ ልብስ 'three garments'); spoken ሠለስ (śäläs) (?) before a feminine noun such as እመት, ሠለስቱ with a masculine · after a noun, 'third' (ወልድከ ፫ 'your third son'), the spoken ordinal ሣልስ (śalləs) (?)
glossary.፺፬: ፺፬ — 94, spoken ተስዓ ወአርባዕቱ (täsʿa wä-ʾarbaʿtu) 'ninety-four'; chapter number (numeral)
